correctness.rationale: Exact D_m numerator formula is algebraically reindexed with A=a-m+1, B=b-n, giving c_(k+j)=sum_A W_m(A)W_m(mj-kA). Substituting A/m turns this into trapezoidal quadrature for a compact piecewise-quadratic tent product. Finite breakpoint control gives O_k(m^-2) error; direct integration gives central (6k-2), interior 6(k-|j|), endpoint 1 after scaling 6k². Polynomial factorization follows from a three-tap/triangular convolution. For coprime m,n, the Fejér-character sum establishes no unit-circle roots and reciprocal pairing. Multiplicity-sensitive Rouché disks of radii O_k(m^-2) at simple roots and O_k(m^-1) at double kth roots give precise root labeling and simplicity for sufficiently large n. value.rationale: The exact distribution of zeros as the Hartogs exponent (n+k)/n approaches 1 is an intrinsically motivated degeneration problem: known finite kernel zeros may approach the boundary of the zero-free limiting domain in distinct ways. The theorem provides an all-k universal interior outlier, a regular polygon of boundary accumulation points and quantitative approach rates, not just a redisplay of a finite coefficient table. This distinguishes a persistent coordinate-product root from k-1 escaping spectral roots, is useful to organize fine Bergman zero-set geometry, and extends beyond the previously covered k<=3 limits.
